objective: Every public spacecraft ephemeris source and spacecraft feeding the combined catalog; no spacecraft or source sampling

selection.files: Inventory every source record/file available at snapshot, no pagination or per-invocation truncation; fingerprint the frozen census
selection.arcs: One latest metadata-eligible issue per source/object, maximizing available registered lead (7, then 3, then 1); record all objects even if none is scoreable
selection.duplicates: Keep distinct source/quality lineages; deduplicate exact content; overlapping precise files sorted by name, last wins

physics: Reuse the unchanged published-truth module/configuration/estimator settings, retaining 70x70 FFM, all registered forces and covariance

truthPolicy.precise: Reconstructed agency reference ephemerides, quality basis retained
truthPolicy.operator: Cross-version near-epoch heads, separately labeled operator-reconstruction; future predictions alone are not independent truth
truthPolicy.singleForecast: Within-product continuation/closure only, separate from forecast-accuracy results
truthPolicy.gp: Element-set feeds remain in source census but do not count as independent high-accuracy truth

failurePolicy: Never omit an object because a fit, covariance, parser or coverage check fails; report all source/object denominators and reasons
verification: Complete census accounting and deterministic representative real-module replay for every available source/reader; no pass for unsupported sources or absent truth
